verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents single-call retrieval: hybrid search returns the most relevant memories and document chunks, and user profiles are described as 'always ready' context. Nothing shows the result arrives as an assembled, prompt-ready block or can be capped to a token budget. missing for 10: token-budget parameter or limit, prompt-ready formatted context block output, documentation of combining profile and search results into one assembled context, independent or hands-on corroboration.
